_what: A room brought onto the street by tools/import-room.py from an artifact somebody built with their own AI. Everything here is read off that artifact's FOR THE STREET comment or measured from the room as it renders; nothing is typed. check-contrast.py holds the pairs, check-jukebox.py checks the tracks, and re-importing replaces this file whole.
title: Words, Bud, Beats
description: A salon at desert dusk where Kristina Brooke pairs music with words and cannabis.
name: Kristina Brooke
light: Low desert dusk through one west window, falling across the far wall and throwing every shadow east.
words: Kristina Brooke's words: the opening under "What's here" (from "An intimate salon of words" through "Talking is never required."); the shelf note ("Each record holds a grouping..." with its Zibaldone link); all six records (words, dates, songs, strains, liner notes) as she sent them; the House notes allergy sign and Tidal line; the strain key; the door description. Drafted by Claude for her to change: the section headings, the record field labels and "Liner notes", the House notes line about press-to-play, the Open mic invitation, the Copy button messages, the pairing slip (adapted from the Stimpunks.World Zibaldone attribution slip, CC BY-SA 4.0), and the credits wording. Claude added the artist for record 3 from its Tidal page. House rule for words: 30 or fewer each, original or quoted, never song lyrics. Added on the street by Stimpunks, for her to change: the play button on each record and the House notes line about it, and the Copy script reads the room's address off the page.
built_with: Claude, an AI model made by Anthropic

tracks.title: Last Time (I Seen the Sun)
tracks.artist: Alice Smith, Miles Caton and Sinners Movie

pairs.where: p.wbb-sign “This space is free from all of the nine, and”
p “Links to single songs on Tidal will allow yo”
p “Each record holds a grouping of words, music”
a “Grown Ass Woman by Chapel Hart”
a “Last Time (I Seen the Sun) by Alice Smith, M”
a “For the First Time by Darius Rucker”
